assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Right isosceles triangle ABC with the right angle at C; D on CA and E on CB with CD = CE; blue segment AE; red segments CK and DL perpendicular to AE with K and L on AB; AC extended below C to F (dashed) and the red dashed segment BF parallel to CK.

difficulty_rationale: The decisive idea is the auxiliary point F on the extension of AC, which turns the problem into equal intercepts on parallel lines.
